title.ay: Hebaristo, munasiña layku jiwki uka sauce

summary.qu: Huk qucha llaqtapi iskay sapallan runakuna kawsanku, paykunaqa iskaylla kawsakunku: Hebaristo sutiyoq salsa, Evaristo Mazuelos sutiyoq farmacian, payqa juezpa churinpa munayninta suyaspa kawsarqan.
summary.ay: Mä quta thiyankir markana, pä sapakiw jakapxi, jupanakax payar uñtasit jakapxiwa: Hebaristo sat mä salsa, Evaristo Mazuelos sat mä boterista, jupax juez ukan phuchhapan munasiñap suyt'asisaw jakasiwayi.
